title: Ruled
note: The site in print: a 3px corner on controls, square panels, one resting rule under a field, ink on mint for what is chosen, hard shadows only under what floats.
css: radius: split radius.md into a control radius (button, icon-button, text-field, text-area, select, combobox, the pickers, segment, pagination, checkbox) and a surface radius (card, alert, menu, popover, listbox, option, tooltip, accordion-item, tree, tab, progress, skeleton). Ruled wants 3px or the site's 4px on controls and 0 on surfaces; today one token rounds both, so cards, menus and popovers carry 3px they should not. Alert also multiplies it (calc(var(--_radius-md) * 1.5), 4.5px) and tab adds 2px: both should read the surface radius as it is.

button, icon-button: give hover its own shadow token instead of shadow.control, which is also the resting shadow of every field, checkbox, radio and switch. Then .control:hover { transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--violet-color-text-primary) } and .control:active { transform: none; box-shadow: none }: the site's hard offset as the lift, and a press that sets it back down.

text-field, text-area, select, combobox, date-picker, time-picker, slider, segmented-control, progress .label; data-grid header cells; option-group heading; tree label: font-family: var(--violet-font-family-mono); font-size: var(--violet-type-caption-xs-size); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em. No component reads font.family.mono today, so the site's label voice is missing from every form.

text-field, text-area, select, combobox, the pickers .control-frame: background: var(--violet-color-field-background) in place of var(--_surface-page), and read color.field.background.readonly, color.field.placeholder, color.field.text and color.field.border.focus. The theme sets all five and nothing reads them, so a field is the page's own colour and cannot be a lighter well.

badge .badge: border-radius from the control radius, not radius.round; font-family mono, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.06em; font-weight 500 (it reads --_type-label-weight, which its token block never defines, so it falls to 400). The site's chips are square mono labels; a pill is the one shape here the site never draws.

button .control[data-appearance="quiet"]: border-color: transparent; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px (the site's text link), with background: var(--_action-secondary-hover) on hover. With a 1px border.subtle edge it reads as a disabled secondary button beside a real one.

slider, range-slider .thumb: box-shadow: var(--_shadow-control); border: 1px solid var(--violet-color-text-primary) in place of shadow.floating, which puts a 4px hard shadow under a 22px thumb. .rail: block-size 2px, so the track is a rule.

every focus style: read size.focus-ring.width (only data-grid does; the rest write 2px), and draw fields the way buttons are drawn: outline: var(--violet-size-focus-ring-width) solid var(--_focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px, in place of box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px and the border colour-mix.
progress: --_progress-track: var(--violet-color-border-subtle) (the 84% mix of surface.subtle disappears on paper); --_progress-radius: 0; --_progress-track-size: 6px. A bar of ink on a ruled line.

segment :host([checked]) .button: background: var(--violet-color-action-primary-background); color: var(--violet-color-action-primary-text); border-color: transparent; box-shadow: none. The site's chip row marks the chosen chip in ink; a paper chip on stone-100 is a faint difference.

one disabled treatment: opacity is 0.55 on button and pagination, 0.65 on fields, 0.6 on checkbox, radio and switch, 0.7 on segmented-control, 0.72 on pagination's host. Use 0.5 everywhere, on the control and its label.

persona: the six tones are fixed hex values (#b9d3b0, #b8d2eb, #e8d09c, #e2b29d, #cfbddb, #c8cfdb) mixed into the card colour. Draw them from the theme (surface.subtle, control.selected.background, the three state backgrounds) with a 1px border.strong edge, so an avatar is not the only blue on the page.

alert .leading: drop the tinted disc (background: transparent; inline-size of the icon) and set the icon at 20px in the tone's text colour. The box is already ruled in that colour; the disc is a second, softer shape inside it.
